scope: Retain the Exar Kun Open Hand encounter while making its authored 125000-point sacrifice heal authoritative instead of allowing a post-NGE healing-reduction expertise statistic to rewrite it.

eraEvidence.basis: The expansion encounter is intentionally retained, but Publish 14.1 player progression has no NGE expertise_healing_reduction statistic. The encounter authors supplied a fixed heal amount and a separate eight-step sacrifice-buff ladder.
findings: heroic_exar_kun.tab directly spawns heroic_exar_open_hand and attaches theme_park.heroic.exar_kun.open_hand.
The creature definition and mobile template remain live inputs for the spawned boss.
A successful sacrifice kills the selected cultist, increments encounter state, applies the corresponding sacrifice buff, heals Open Hand, and plays the retained effect.
The removed arithmetic was the only NGE expertise reference in open_hand.java and could reduce the authored 125000-point heal according to an expertise-derived stat on the boss.

buildEvidence.lineEndingPolicy: the touched legacy open_hand.java blob was normalized to the repository's declared LF policy and trailing whitespace was removed
buildEvidence.sourceTest: passed; live spawn and creature reachability, the exact authored heal, cultist selection and death, encounter state, eight buff tiers, and client effect were authenticated without NGE expertise authority
buildEvidence.focusedJavaCompile: passed in an ephemeral in-memory output directory that was removed immediately; emitted bytecode retained sacrificeAdd and 125000 with no expertise_healing_reduction or enhanced-stat lookup symbol

auditBoundary.closedInThisMilestone: Open Hand's sacrifice heal can no longer be reduced by the post-NGE expertise_healing_reduction statistic.
auditBoundary.preserved: The retained Exar Kun spawn route, boss definition, encounter scheduling, cultist selection, cultist death, encounter counter, eight sacrifice buffs, heal effect, share-pain, and spark mechanics remain available.
auditBoundary.notClaimedComplete: Nandina's separate authored heal of Gorvo remains the next known Java consumer of expertise_healing_reduction and is intentionally tracked as a later bounded milestone.

requiredBeforeReady: Run a clean full Java dependency rebuild and x64 server build from the pinned direct source.
Authenticate source/work parity and emitted Open Hand bytecode in the deployment gate.
Restart the server, prove the live process maps the built x64 binary, and audit post-start logs.
